plan.title: Adopt the cloud key alias/example-staging-signing
plan.summary: Reads the public key of an existing cloud key, checks its policy, fixes and records its OpenPGP creation time, and writes its certificate. The key itself is not created or changed.

steps.title: Check the plan
steps.detail: ritueel compares the plan with the bundle and asks you to type the first eight characters of the digest: a92d5e60.

steps.title: Read the key
steps.detail: Asks the cloud provider for the public key and the policy of the key, with the admin role named in the configuration.

steps.title: Check the policy
steps.detail: Checks the policy against the rules: digests only, no new replicas and no move of the primary Region except for the break-glass principal. If a rule fails, the plan stops here and says which.

steps.title: Fix the creation time
steps.detail: The key has no OpenPGP creation time of its own, so ritueel fixes one and records it. It cannot change later without changing the fingerprint.
steps.whatChanges: A creation time in the record

steps.title: Write the certificate
steps.detail: The key signs, digest only, as the ceremony role, in the session you already have: its X.509 root certificate and its OpenPGP self-signature (two), the two revocation signatures and the removal authorisation made at birth (three), and, as the new root, the first root list, the SSH CA key list and its own CRL (three). Eight signatures; a cloud key has no touch.
steps.whatChanges: The first root of the bundle, A

steps.title: Write the record
steps.detail: Writes the record of this ceremony and its transcript.
steps.whatChanges: One new record in the history
